system.effect:
Prerequisites: @UUID[Compendium.ptu.references.Item.eXaVErJ2SXyUiMNd]
Scene – Free Action
Target: A foe within 5m
Effect: The target choses either to Cower or to Panic. If it Cowers, then it loses its next available Shift action, and loses 1 CS in both Attack and Special Attack. If it Panics, the foe loses 1 CS in both Defense and Special Defense, and at the start of its next turn, it must spend its Shift action to move as far away as possible from you, provoking @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.lhaZXnE2PfttWp41]{AoO} as normal, heedless of hazards. Regardless of the choice, the target is @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.wqzPWKMbwvOWLVoI] until the end of its next turn.
